ctaHeading: Ready to Transform Your Brunswick Garden?
aboutText: Home has been providing landscaping and gardening services in Brunswick for over 9 years. Specialising in garden design, maintenance, and property care, we transform outdoor spaces into beautiful, functional areas. Our passion for landscape perfection ensures tailored solutions to meet your vision. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote.
servicesText: From design to maintenance, we offer a full range of landscaping services in Brunswick. Our experienced team handles everything from lawn mowing to irrigation installation, ensuring your property looks its best year-round.

services.title: Garden Design and Maintenance
services.desc: Custom garden designs and regular maintenance to keep your outdoor space thriving.

services.title: Lawn Care Services
services.desc: Professional lawn mowing, edge cutting, and grass laying for a pristine lawn.

services.title: Property Maintenance
services.desc: General property services including hedge trimming and brush cutting for neat grounds.

services.title: Irrigation and Water Systems
services.desc: Installation and maintenance of sprinklers, timers, and irrigation systems.

services.title: Landscaping and Hardscaping
services.desc: Landscaping projects with pavers, retaining walls, and stepping stones.

services.title: Garden Supplies and Construction
services.desc: Delivery of mulch, soil, and aggregate, plus brick and block laying services.
